summary:
陶氏化學 EPS -0.14 美元優於預期、虧損收窄，但營收年減6.1%，化工景氣低迷仍未脫困。
• EPS -0.14 美元，虧損優於預期（差異收窄 51.70%）
• 成本控管與資產組合調整減緩虧損
• 包裝與特用化學品需求相對具韌性
• 管理層持續推動成本與資本紀律
ai_view:
訊號偏弱但有止穩跡象：EPS 雖優於預期、虧損收窄，但仍為負值且營收持續年減，凸顯化工產業仍處下行循環。優於預期主要來自成本控管與虧損減緩，而非需求回升。短期股價或因虧損收窄而稍獲喘息，但基本面尚未轉佳。中期追蹤產品利差（spread）、開工率、需求復甦訊號、自由現金流與股息可持續性。化工為深週期股，景氣落底時點為關鍵催化劑。

需留意：仍處淨虧損，營收年減 6.1%，化工景氣下行未止；原料與能源價格波動壓抑利差（spread）；全球需求疲弱與產能過剩風險；股息覆蓋能力在虧損下受檢視

summary_en:
Dow posted a smaller-than-expected $0.14 loss but revenue fell 6.1%, with the chemical downcycle still weighing.
• EPS of -$0.14, a smaller loss than expected (51.70% better)
• Cost control and portfolio adjustments mitigate losses
• Packaging and specialty demand relatively resilient
• Management maintains cost and capital discipline

ai_view_en:
Signal is weak with tentative stabilization: although EPS beat with a narrower loss, it remains negative and revenue keeps declining, underscoring an ongoing chemical downcycle. The beat stems mainly from cost control and loss mitigation rather than recovering demand. Near term the stock may get modest relief from the smaller loss, but fundamentals have not yet improved. Mid term, track product spreads, utilization rates, demand recovery signals, free cash flow and dividend sustainability. As a deep cyclical, the cycle trough is the key catalyst.

Watch：Still a net loss with revenue down 6.1%; chemical downcycle persists; Feedstock and energy price swings pressure spreads; Weak global demand and overcapacity risk; Dividend coverage scrutinized amid losses
beat_or_miss: 低於預期（仍虧損）：EPS 雖優於預期 51.70%但仍為 -0.14 美元、營收年減 6.11%，反映景氣低迷，獲利尚未轉正。
